checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: disable the combat FLEE button with a plain reason when fuel is below the 8 the engine requires; failing-first source pin and browser check

impact_assessment.why: Reading the combat code: flee is the guaranteed escape but costs 8 fuel; the button never disables, so a low-fuel player clicks it and only gets a log error
impact_assessment.benefits: Players see why the escape is unavailable before an unwinnable fight goes wrong
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: literal 8 matches the engine and the button label, pinned by the test; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Test reads the engine constant and fails if they drift

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: raise the settings overlay above the main menu so SETTINGS opened from the menu is visible and clickable; failing-first CSS test and real-click check

impact_assessment.why: Real Edge at 1280x720: clicking SETTINGS in the main menu opens the overlay at z-index 5100 beneath the menu at 10000, which still covers it and takes the clicks
impact_assessment.benefits: Settings (display, audio, gameplay, controls) are reachable from the first screen
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: other overlays keep their order; concurrency: none; state: none; CSS only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Click a settings control and the close button in a real browser; layering test

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: menu status line shows failures in the error colour and is a live region; failing-first source pin and browser check

impact_assessment.why: Real Edge: LOAD FROM SLOT on an empty slot prints 'ERROR: No save file...' in the same green as success, and the line is not announced to assistive tech
impact_assessment.benefits: A failed save/load/delete reads as a failure at a glance and is announced
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: one CSS class toggled
impact_assessment.mitigation: Check colour in the browser for failure and success

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: character creation reads the origin catalog from the cached /api/catalogs payload when no game state has loaded yet; failing-first source pin and a genuine first-launch browser check

impact_assessment.why: Real Edge on a fresh load: cockpit.state is null before a game starts, so the origin hint and +N ORIGIN skill tags added earlier never appear on a player's first New Game
impact_assessment.benefits: The first-run creation screen explains each origin, as designed
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: reuses the global catalogCache already loaded at startup; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: State catalog still wins when present; verify on a fresh page with no forced state load

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: AU ruler tick labels reserve their rectangle in the radar label collision list so body and flagship names route around them; failing-first pin and 720p/1080p captures

impact_assessment.why: Real Edge at 1280x720: the VF-FLAGSHIP label sits on the 13.0 AU ruler mark; tick text is drawn without registering in the collision list
impact_assessment.benefits: Names and ruler marks stay legible together
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: ticks reserve space so a crowded map may drop a variant to its short name; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Compare label counts before and after at 720p and 1080p; priority-4 labels still always drawn

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: the creation origin tag shows the gain the rank-10 cap leaves, and 'ORIGIN MAXED' when none; failing-first pin and browser check

impact_assessment.why: Real Edge: maxing Engineering as an Engineer leaves it at 10 because origin training is capped at rank 10, yet the tag still promised +2 ORIGIN
impact_assessment.benefits: Players see what the origin will really add before spending points
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: cap mirrors character.py's rank-10 rule, pinned by a test; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Test ties the UI cap to the engine rule text; browser check at 9, 10 and low values
